rows.abstract: "Martial Law Victims Corporation Act of 2000." Rationale: Government has the moral obligation to give human rights victims the indemnification due them. Delaying it would further the sufferings of thos who were tortured, illegally detained and whoserelatives disappeared or were killed. Furthermore, human rights victims have every right to seek redress independent of the court cases against the Marcoses. > This measure proposes to indemnify these victims with the establishment of the Martial Law Victims Compensation Fund, consisting of one-third (1/3) of the ill-gotten Swiss bank assets to be forfeited from the estate of Ferdinand and Imelda Marcos, now being held in escrow by the Philippine National Bank. rows.author: C091
rows.title_full: AN ACT BANNING THE CHAIN DISTRIBUTION PLANS OR PYRAMID SALES SCHEMES AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE REPUBLIC ACT NUMBERED SEVENTY-THREE HUNDRED AND NINETY-FOUR AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: "Pyramid Sales Ban Act of 2000." Chain distribution plans or pyramid sales schemes mean sales devices whereby a person, upon condition that he makes an investment, is granted by the manufacturers, PRODUCERS, IMPORTERS, OPERATORS or [his] THEIR representative a right to recruit for profit one or more additional persons who will also be granted such right to recruit condition of making similar investments. Provided, that the profits of the person employing such a plan are derived primarily from the recruitment of the other persons into the plan rather than the same of consumer products, services and credit. Provided, further, that the limitation on the number of participants does not change the nature of the plan. THE SECURITIES AND EXCHANGEE COMMISSION SHALL MOTU PROPIO CANCEL REGISTRATIONS OF CORPORATIONS INVOLVED IN PYRAMID SALES SCHEMES. THE DEPARTMENT OF TRANDE AND INDUSTRY SHALL EXERCISE THE SAME POWER INSOFAR AS SOLE PROPRIETORS AND PARTNERSHIPS ARE CONCERNED.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on TRADE AND INDUSTRY since 2000-09-19

rows.author: C059
rows.title_full: AN ACT DECLARING A NATIONAL POLICY ON PEACE ZONES
rows.abstract: "The Peace Zones Policy Act of 2000." A peace zone is a people-initiate d, community-based arrangement in a local geographical area which residents themselves declare to be off-limits to armed conflict primarily to protect the civilians there and also to contribute to the more comprehensive peace progress. There is a need, therefore, to not only clarify concept of Peace Zones but also, more importantly, set a national policy of openness, respect and recognition of this valuable Filipino innovation and contribution to peace-building. This would complement and deepen a comprehensive national peace policy.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LOCAL GOVERNMENT since 2000-09-20

rows.author: C130
rows.title_full: AN ACT GRANTING FIRST PREFERENCE TO THE CLAIMS FOR DAMAGES OF VICTIMS OF HUMAN RIGHTS VIOLATIONS IN THE DISPOSITION OF THE ACCOUNTS AND ASSETS OF THE LATE PRESIDENT FERDINAND MARCOS FORFEITED TO THE PHILIPPINE GOVERNMENT AS ILL-GOTTEN WEALTH
rows.abstract: "Law on Compensation of Victims of Human Rights Violations." Any provision of existing law to the contrary notwithstanding , claims for damages of victims of human rights violations which are adjudicated in favor of the victims or their heirs by proper courts within and outside the country's jurisdiction shall be given first preference over all other claims to the forfeited accounts or the proceeds of assets of the late President Ferdinant Marcos adjudged to be ill-gotten wealth and forfeited to the Philippine government. Such preferential claims shall include the favorable judgment won by 9,539 victims of human rights violations during the martial law regime in the human rights class action lawsuit before the U.S. District Court for the DDistrict of Hawaii in the amount of US$1.9 billion and the "Agreement of Compromise and Settlement" in the amount of US$150 million.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on CIVIL, POLITICAL AND HUMAN RIGHTS since 2000-09-20

rows.abstract: "Deadly Driver Reduction Act of 2000." This bill seeks to put into place a piece of legislation that will provide stiffer penalties to a person caught driving a motor vehicle under the influence of alcohol or prohibited drugs.
